question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**offers**" means to present or provide something for someone to accept or reject as desired. (प्रदान करता है)
 
• In this context, **"offers"** appropriately fills the blank, indicating that literature provides insight into the human experience.
 
• The other options: "**denies**," "**suggests**," and "**garners**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Literature is a reflection of society and often offers__ insight into the human experience.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Denies (नकारता है)**: means to refuse to admit the truth or existence of something.
 
• **Suggests (सुझाव देता है)**: means to put forward for consideration; imply as a possibility.
 
• **Garners (एकत्र करता है)**: means to gather or collect something, especially information or approval.
